title: Svelte: Setup empty docgen and story snippet skeleton
body:
Closes #

<!-- If your PR is related to an issue, provide the number(s) above; if it resolves multiple issues, be sure to break them up (e.g. "closes #1000, closes #1001"). -->

<!--

Thank you for contributing to Storybook! Please submit all PRs to the `next` branch unless they are specific to the current release. Storybook maintainers cherry-pick bug and documentation fixes into the `main` branch as part of the release process, so you shouldn't need to worry about this. For additional guidance: https://storybook.js.org/docs/contribute

-->

## What I did

This PR setup ta skeleton for the incoming work on te port of addon-svelte with OSA into the repo.

- `@storybook/svelte`: registers a docgen worker (`internal/docgen-worker`) and a story-docs provider. `buildDocgenPayload` / `buildStoryDocsPayload` return `undefined` for now.
- Core: `createLazyDocgenMiddleware` accepts a `storyFileTest` option. The default only matches CSF files, so Svelte CSF (`.svelte`) entries never reached a provider.
- Core: adds `svelte2tsx` as a components-manifest docgen engine. Without one, enabling `experimentalDocgenServer` + `componentsManifest` in a Svelte project hits the `meta.docgen` invariant.
- Docgen harness: `svelte-osa-baselines.test.ts` records `osa-payload` / `osa-argtypes` / `osa-description` snapshots for the 15 Svelte fixtures (empty today), so follow-up PRs show progress as snapshot diffs. Parity with the legacy argTypes is tracked per fixture as `it.fails` markers, promoted to hard gates through `LEGACY_PARITY`.
